title: How Labour Conditions Evolve
goal: Express proportional trends and gradual shifts in automation, training and job stability using cuanto más and a medida que.
grammar: cuanto más... más / menos and a medida que in labour trends

items: I can link two proportional labour trends with *cuanto más / menos* and agree *cuanto* before a noun.
I can describe gradual workplace shifts with *a medida que*.
I can discuss automation, productivity, staff turnover, training and career paths.
